stock.description: Trigiant Group Limited operates as an investment holding company, primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of a wide array of cables and related components. These products are specifically designed for mobile communications and telecommunication equipment within the People's Republic of China. The company's Feeder Cable division provides essential cables for transmitting and receiving radio signals, as well as components for telecommunications infrastructure. This segment also produces specialized leaky cables, crucial for wireless mobile communications, remote control, and alarm systems, facilitating radio frequency signal transmission and antenna data exchange in challenging reception environments like subways, tunnels, underground areas, and building interiors. Its Optical Fibre Cable and Related Products segment delivers cables fundamental for long-distance data transmission across both fixed and wireless telecommunication networks. The Flame-Retardant Flexible Cable Series offers cables designed for internal connections in power systems, mobile cable transmission and distribution setups, and communication switch systems where an uninterrupted power supply is paramount. The New-Type Electronic Components division supplies various advanced parts, including sensing products, optical splitters, jumpers for linking wireless antennas to feeder cables and other communication apparatus, connectors for integrating radio frequency circuits, and antenna lightning arresters that safeguard high-frequency equipment by being installed between the device and its feeder cable. Additionally, the "Others" category encompasses a range of accessories such as couplers, combiners, feeder wall plates, adjustable stands, waterproof sealing clay, insulating tape, cable ties, and feeder hoisting grips. Beyond its domestic operations, Trigiant also exports its products to international markets, including Brazil, India, Russia, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. The company was founded in 2007 and maintains its headquarters in Yixing, People's Republic of China.
